appDesc.message: Backs up your own X posts, replies and quotes to local storage as you publish them.

searchPlaceholder.message: Search text, Tweet ID or author

emptyNone.message: No backups yet. Post or reply normally on x.com, then come back and hit refresh.

emptyMediaOnly.message: No text — probably a media-only post

thumbRemoteMotion.message: Not cached locally — this poster frame is loaded from the network

thumbRemote.message: Not cached locally — loaded from the network; the archive only has the URL

thumbCachedMotionGif.message: GIF cached locally (stored as mp4), plays offline

badgeBackfilledTitle.message: Recovered from your profile timeline. It was published on another device (your phone, say), so the extension could not see it happen. The backup time is when the sweep ran, not when it was posted.

badgeSupersededTitle.message: This post was edited later; the current version is $1

pollNoChoices.message: Poll: the choices were not returned with the publish response, so only the card id was archived

linkTargetTitle.message: Real destination behind the t.co shortlink: $1

findPreviousTitle.message: Find the pre-edit version in the archive ($1)

findNextTitle.message: Find the newer version in the archive ($1)

cleanupSummaryCount.message: Clean up by category ($1 to clean)

cleanupNote.message: Two categories you may not want to keep. The first is the older versions left behind when you edit a post — the current version is always kept in full. The second is the local backup of a post you have already deleted on X.

diagXhrHook.message: XHR hook (the transport publishing actually uses)

diagSeen.message: CreateTweet requests seen on this page

diagPostFailed.message: Records parsed here but never delivered

diagDeleteSeen.message: Delete requests seen on this page

diagTimelineSeen.message: Profile timelines read on this page

diagLinksUnmatched.message: Link fills with no record to fill

diagMediaFromArchive.message: Media · not at the origin, taken from the archive

optThumbs.message: Show network thumbnails when not cached

optMedia.message: Cache media files locally (needs an extra permission)

optBackfillMedia.message: Also download media for recovered posts (can be a lot at once)

optCaptureReplies.message: Also record replies (recovered from your profile's Replies tab)

okCaptureRepliesOn.message: Replies recording on — open the Replies tab on your own profile and scroll down

choiceIntro.message: Six optional behaviours, each with a cost worth knowing before it is paid. Only the extras are decided here.

choiceConnectionsCost.message: Scroll your own Following or Followers list and every account you scroll past is written down — handle, display name, bio and a few counts. Nobody else's list is ever read.

choiceMediaCost.message: Downloads every image and video into this extension's own storage, so it stays readable offline. Needs permission for pbs.twimg.com and video.twimg.com — Chrome asks for it when you confirm below.

choiceBackfillCost.message: A single sweep of your profile can queue hundreds of downloads at once, and what gets downloaded is the files themselves. With this off, a recovered post keeps the media URL only.

choiceWarning.message: This archive lives only in your browser. Clearing browser data, uninstalling the extension or deleting your profile destroys it with no way back — export the JSON or the ZIP yourself, regularly, as the backup that survives.

choiceRepliesCost.message: Reads your profile's Replies tab as well as its Posts. Every entry there is a whole conversation, so this can add a large number of rows in one go.

choiceThumbsCost.message: Opening this popup fetches thumbnails from twimg.com, which tells X that the archive was opened. With this off you get a placeholder where the picture would be; nothing already cached is affected.

choiceCoreNote.message: Your own posts, edits and deletions are backed up either way — this decides the extras only, and every one of them can be changed later under Settings.

optChoiceWayback.message: Fill in old posts from the Internet Archive

choiceWaybackCost.message: The only one of the five that sends the extension to a server that is not X. Ticking it opens one more panel to read; the browser is only asked for the permission after that.

okChoiceSaved.message: Choices saved — you can change any of them under Settings

exportArchiveTitle.message: tweets.json + every cached media file + two indexes, packed into one ZIP

exportHostedTitle.message: Export the shape GitHub hosting wants: loose files + index.json, not a ZIP. Pick an empty folder

fillMediaTitle.message: Scan the whole archive and download the images and videos that have a URL but no local file. Anything already cached is skipped. Media X no longer serves cannot be recovered.

busyFillMedia.message: Scanning the archive for media without files…

okFillMedia.message: Queued $1 posts ($2 have media). Already-cached files are skipped; downloads continue in the background.

okFillMediaOverflow.message: $1 did not fit the queue — click again to continue.

errFillMediaOff.message: Turn on "Cache media files locally" first

errFillMediaNoPerm.message: pbs.twimg.com / video.twimg.com access has not been granted — toggle "Cache media files locally" once to grant it

warnReload.message: After reloading or updating the extension you must refresh every open x.com page (F5), otherwise posts published in those pages will not be backed up — reloading kills the backup channel in pages that were already open.

noteStorage.message: Data lives in the extension's own IndexedDB. Uninstalling the extension, deleting your Chrome profile or clearing extension data destroys it, so export the JSON or the ZIP yourself from time to time as a backup.

noteBackfill.message: Opening your own profile and scrolling down automatically recovers the posts that load there. Nothing is recovered in any other situation.

noteSnapshot.message: Every JSON export is a complete snapshot, not a continuation of an earlier one. Chrome never overwrites a same-named file — it renames the new one to (1), (2)… — so once you have a newer JSON, the older export files can be deleted.

errReadDb.message: Could not read the local database: $1

errOpenDb.message: Could not open the extension database: $1

ownAuthorsNote.message: These ids are how the extension tells your posts from everybody else's. It learns them from captured posts and only ever adds — learn the wrong one and it starts archiving that account's timeline too.

ownAuthorsNone.message: None learned yet. Posting once in this browser is what teaches it the first one.

ownAuthorsThisOne.message: You (the profile card in the archive)

ownAuthorsOther.message: Not the one on the profile card — forget it if it is not you

ownAuthorsReload.message: Reload every open x.com tab afterwards — each page keeps its own copy of the old list.

okOwnAuthorForgotten.message: That id is no longer treated as you.

errHostedNeedsTab.message: This needs a folder picker, which cannot run in the popup — press “Open in a tab” first, then this button.

errNoDirectoryPicker.message: This browser cannot pick a folder, so the hosted layout cannot be written

errHostedNotEmpty.message: That folder already has something in it. Pick an empty one — writing into it would leave files behind from an older export, and the new index.json does not know about them.

errDeletionsUnreadable.message: the deletion log could not be read ($1), so the export was stopped rather than writing a file that looks complete but is missing every recorded deletion

okPurged.message: Deleted $1 local backups (nothing on X was touched)

okBackfillMediaOn.message: Recovered posts will also download their media

okBackfillMediaOff.message: Recovered posts keep media URLs only, no files

okMediaOn.message: Local media caching on: newly captured posts will download their media in the background; a failure never affects the text record

errMediaPermission.message: Permission for pbs.twimg.com / video.twimg.com was not granted, so media caching stays off

choiceNeedsTab.message: Do the first-run setup in a tab — use “Open in a tab” below. Two of the choices need a browser permission.

busyExporting.message: Exporting from the local database, please keep this window open…

okArchiveSkipped.message: ; $1 media records have no file body (caching was off when they were captured)

okHostedWritten.message: Hosted folder written: $1 records, $2 media files ($3), in “$4”. That whole folder is an archive ready to push to GitHub. index.json is written last — the reader reads it first.

okHostedProblems.message: ; $1 items could not be written, see the notice shown during the export

exportCancelled.message: Export cancelled: no file was written

okExportStarted.message: Download started: $1 records to $2. This browser cannot confirm the download finished — check that the file arrived before relying on it

okArchiveStarted.message: Download started: $1 records + $2 media files ($3). This browser cannot confirm the download finished — check that the file arrived before relying on it

optCaptureConnections.message: Record your follow lists (Following and Followers)

okCaptureConnectionsOn.message: Follow lists on — open your own Following or Followers page and scroll

noteConnections.message: Every account on your own Following and Followers pages is saved as you scroll them — handle, name, bio and counts. Nothing is ever read from anyone else's list. Handles change, so the numeric id is what this archive keys on. Absence is never recorded: someone missing from the list has simply not been scrolled past yet.

noteConnectionsInactive.message: Not active yet: this browser has not seen you publish, so it does not know which account is yours. Post or reply once on x.com and it starts working.

optWayback.message: Fill in older posts from the Internet Archive (needs an extra permission)

noteWaybackOff.message: Off. Turning this on can pull your older posts back from the Internet Archive — ones from before the extension was installed, ones published on another machine, ones already deleted. It is the only feature here that goes online by itself.

noteWaybackNoHandle.message: No handle yet. The archive is indexed by handle — and if the account was renamed, the old name has to be swept separately.

noteWaybackPaused.message: Stopped at $1 of $2. Reason: $3. The position is kept — pressing again once that is sorted continues from here.

noteWaybackDone.message: Last run: added $1 · filled in $2 · skipped $3 · failed $4

waybackPausedArchive.message: the archive stopped answering, so it stopped asking

waybackPanelNote.message: The data comes from web.archive.org — public archived copies of your own posts.

noteWaybackAll.message: With this on, the number above stops counting and one press runs until there is nothing left (for this account that could be hours). Closing the browser part way through loses nothing — the position is on disk and the next press carries on.

noteWaybackMore.message: That batch finished. $1 of $2 left — pressing again carries on rather than starting over.

okWaybackStartedAll.message: Started, running to the end of the list. Stop is available at any point.

btnWaybackFillTitle.message: Fetch only what this archive does not already have. A post it has costs no request at all, so this is quick.

btnWaybackVerifyTitle.message: Re-fetch posts it already has. The archived copy carries things a live capture cannot see — who was allowed to reply, where the links sat in the text — and those fill in. It does NOT overwrite your text, your counts or where a row came from. Much slower.

busyWayback.message: Asking the archive what it has…

okWaybackStarted.message: Started, up to $1 snapshots this pass. It keeps running after the popup closes.

okWaybackDone.message: Finished: added $1 · filled in $2 · skipped $3 · failed $4

okWaybackCancelling.message: Stopping… the request already in flight will finish, and whatever it brought back will not be written.

okWaybackOn.message: On. Fill in the handle, then press “Fetch data” under Import settings below.

errWaybackPermission.message: Permission for web.archive.org was not granted, so this stays off.

errWaybackBadHandle.message: That handle is not valid: letters, digits and underscore only, up to 15.

errWaybackBadBatch.message: The batch size has to be between 1 and 500.

errWaybackNoSnapshots.message: The archive has no snapshots of posts under that handle. It may be misspelled, or the archive may never have crawled that account.

errWaybackArchiveDown.message: Could not reach the Internet Archive. It goes offline for short stretches; try again in a few minutes.

waybackChoiceTitle.message: Pull data from the Internet Archive

waybackChoiceIntro.message: This is the only feature in the extension that goes online by itself. Read what it does before turning it on.

waybackChoiceSource.message: The data comes from web.archive.org — the Internet Archive's public snapshots. They are somebody else's crawl of your posts, not an X API.

waybackChoiceWarning.message: Once you continue, the next thing you see is the browser asking for the permission — and it will only say "read and change your data on web.archive.org". It will not say what for. That sentence is the paragraph above.

diagWaybackEnriched.message: Archive import: filled into existing rows

searchPlaceholderConnections.message: Search handle, name, bio or id

emptyConnections.message: Nobody recorded yet. Open your own Following or Followers page and scroll down — every page you load is added here.

errConnectionsUnreadable.message: the follow lists could not be read ($1), so the export was stopped rather than writing a file that looks complete but is missing everyone you follow

errPageOutdated.message: This page was loaded by an older version of the extension ($1). Reload it to continue.

diagConnectionsSeen.message: Follow lists read on this page

diagConnectionsNoOwner.message: Follow lists dropped — not your account

errProfileUnreadable.message: your profile card could not be read ($1), so the export was stopped rather than writing a file that looks complete but has no header for the reader to draw

diagProfileNoUser.message: Profiles dropped — response carried no account

tzNote.message: All timestamps are UTC. Local time = UTC + offsetMinutes.
